content: The provided text is a list of references and citations from various academic and professional sources related to adolescent health, healthcare services, public health policies, and global health initiatives. It includes journal articles, WHO guidelines, technical briefs, systematic reviews, and policy documents. These references cover a wide range of topics, such as the quality of healthcare services for adolescents, integration of HIV testing in family planning, transitional care models, adolescent-friendly health services, school health services, mental health, environmental health, digital technology use, and sustainable development goals. The citations also include resources on telehealth consultations, gender equality, urban health, and the impact of environmental factors on health.
